scenarios.starting_prompt: setup context generation for my database (only initialize the workspace/experiment files and validate the connection; do not proceed to dataset generation or hill-climbing).
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to setup the auto context generation for my alloydb database (only initialize the workspace/experiment files and validate the connection; do not proceed to dataset generation or hill-climbing). Connection information: datasource name as my-alloydb, project id is cloud-db-nl2sql, region us-central1, cluster whaoyu-test, instance whaoyu-test-primary, database financial. Provide the workspace and experiment settings: Context Set location 'us-central1', enrichment sources 'none', upload draft iterations 'automatically', experiment name 'crema-eval-experiment', and context set id 'crema-eval-experiment'. Verify that the agent generates a valid .context-engineering/tools.yaml and .context-engineering/workspace_state.md (plus .context-engineering/experiments/crema-eval-experiment/hillclimb/experiment_state.md when the experiment is initialized), and explicitly ask the agent to perform validation. Terminate the conversation immediately after the agent successfully set up the files and performed the validation.

scenarios.starting_prompt:
Use context engineering, generate an evaluation dataset consisting of 5 questions for my alloydb database financial in experiment 'crema-eval-experiment' named golden.json (and split into splits/hillclimb.json and splits/holdout.json; do not proceed to bootstrap or evaluation), based on the following two seed NL-SQL pairs:

How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region? A3 contains the data of region; 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' represents for 'issuance after transaction'.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "T1"."account_id") FROM "account" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "district" AS "T2" ON "T1"."district_id" = "T2"."district_id" WHERE "T2"."A3" = 'east Bohemia' AND "T1"."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

How many accounts who have region in Prague are eligible for loans? A3 contains the data of region
SELECT COUNT("T1"."account_id") FROM "account" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "T2" ON "T1"."account_id" = "T2"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "T3" ON "T1"."district_id" = "T3"."district_id" WHERE "T3"."A3" = 'Prague'
scenarios.conversation_plan:
Ask the agent to generate an evaluation dataset for my alloydb database financial in experiment 'crema-eval-experiment' named golden.json. The 'seed' includes the following two golden NL-SQL pairs:

How many accounts who choose issuance after transaction are staying in East Bohemia region? A3 contains the data of region; 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' represents for 'issuance after transaction'.
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "T1"."account_id") FROM "account" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "district" AS "T2" ON "T1"."district_id" = "T2"."district_id" WHERE "T2"."A3" = 'east Bohemia' AND "T1"."frequency" = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

How many accounts who have region in Prague are eligible for loans? A3 contains the data of region
SELECT COUNT("T1"."account_id") FROM "account" AS "T1" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "T2" ON "T1"."account_id" = "T2"."account_id" INNER JOIN "district" AS "T3" ON "T1"."district_id" = "T3"."district_id" WHERE "T3"."A3" = 'Prague'.
When the agent presents a dataset generation plan (evalset_gen_plan.md) or asks for confirmation to validate/expand to 5 questions total, approve the plan immediately and reply yes. Verify that the agent generates the golden dataset and calls split_dataset to create splits/hillclimb.json and splits/holdout.json under the experiment's dataset/ folder. Terminate the conversation immediately after the agent successfully generated the dataset and both split files, even if the agent prompts you to perform evaluation or take next steps.

scenarios.starting_prompt: Use context engineering, generate an evaluation dataset consisting of 10 questions by expanding my evaluation dataset in experiment 'crema-eval-experiment' (golden.json) with more diverse examples using all six variation strategies: paraphrasing, merging, difficulty adjustment (both upscaling and simplification), distraction injection, linguistic variation (typos and synonyms), and value substitution. Also save the audit reports as 'evalset_expansion_report_pair_level.md' and 'evalset_expansion_report_dataset_level.md'.
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to expand the existing golden.json evaluation dataset in experiment 'crema-eval-experiment' by applying variation strategies to the existing pairs. The agent should apply all six strategies: paraphrasing, merging, difficulty adjustment (both upscaling and simplification), distraction injection, linguistic variation (typos and synonyms), and value substitution (which requires running SELECT DISTINCT queries on the database). When the agent presents an expansion plan (evalset_gen_plan.md), confirm it and approve all strategies. When the agent runs SQL execution validation or asks for approval of the validation reports, approve them. Verify that the agent writes the expanded pairs to golden.json, updates splits/hillclimb.json and splits/holdout.json, and produces the audit reports. Terminate the conversation immediately after the agent finishes, even if it prompts you to perform evaluation or take next steps.

scenarios.starting_prompt: create a standalone initial baseline context set file at ./bootstrap_context.json for my alloydb database (at least 2 templates and 2 facets, do not upload or run evaluation).
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to create a standalone initial baseline context set file at ./bootstrap_context.json for my alloydb database (do not upload to the server). Need to have at least 2 templates and 2 facets. When the agent presents the schema summary or candidate templates/facets for review, approve them immediately so it generates and validates ./bootstrap_context.json. Terminate the conversation immediately after the agent successfully created and validated the context set file, even if the agent prompts you to perform evaluation or take next steps.

scenarios.starting_prompt: evaluate the golden dataset at ./golden.json against the local ContextSet at ./bootstrap_context.json for experiment 'crema-eval-experiment'
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to evaluate the golden dataset at ./golden.json against the local ContextSet at ./bootstrap_context.json for experiment 'crema-eval-experiment'. Terminate immediately after the agent runs the evaluation and presents the evaluation results, even if it prompts to continue.

scenarios.starting_prompt: improve the context set based on eval failure (max 1 more iteration) for experiment 'crema-eval-experiment'. Resume the in-progress experiment recorded in the .context-engineering/experiments/crema-eval-experiment/
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to perform hillclimbing for experiment 'crema-eval-experiment' to improve the context set based on eval failure. The agent should run at least one new iteration (v1), and it is acceptable if the agent performs additional retry/recovery iterations (e.g., v2 or re-evaluating v1) to recover from transient API/auth errors or SQL syntax/quoting issues, as well as finalization steps such as holdout evaluation, generalizability analysis, and updating the final report. Terminate the conversation immediately after the agent finishes and reports the results, even if the agent prompts you to take next steps.

scenarios.starting_prompt: improve my context set from scratch (max iterations 1) using the local base context at ./bootstrap_context.json for experiment 'crema-eval-experiment'
scenarios.conversation_plan: Ask the agent to run hillclimb for experiment 'crema-eval-experiment' using the local base context at ./bootstrap_context.json. The agent should evaluate the baseline (v0) and run at least one improvement iteration (v1); it is acceptable if the agent performs additional retry/recovery iterations (e.g., v2 or re-evaluating v1) to recover from transient API/auth errors or SQL syntax/quoting issues, as well as finalization steps such as holdout evaluation, generalizability analysis, and updating the final report. Terminate immediately after the agent successfully performs the hillclimbing task, even if the agent prompts you to continue.
